mediawikiCategories.name: Road maps of state highways in New Jersey

properties.title: Route 1
properties.description:
Route in Jersey City designated to go over unfinished Route 1 Extension; put on this route for the time being
Redesignated over 18N in 1929: renumbered S5 north of Bergen Turnpike

properties.title: Route 2
properties.description: Became Route 17 in 1942

properties.title: Route 4
properties.description:
Route between Rahway and Orange is an approximation
Portion between Freehold and Old Bridge became Route 4A upon completion of bypass

properties.title: Route 4 Spur
properties.description: Intended to link with Atlantic County road running from Bringantine; when Brigantine link was cancelled, 4SA was cancelled too

properties.title: Route 4 Spur A (Planned)
properties.description: Intended to link with Atlantic County road running from Bringantine; when Brigantine link was cancelled, 4SA was cancelled too

properties.title: Route S4B
properties.description: Not constructed west of US-202

properties.title: Route S4D
properties.description: Likely integrated into 55 in 1948

properties.title: Route 4N
properties.description: Grandfathered in from 1917 system

properties.title: Route 5
properties.description: The route between Little Ferry and Ridgefield was intended to be put on what is now Route 46's alignment, with the remaining route to be Route 5A. Rerouting of Route 6 on this alignment scrapped these plans, and in 1929 was cut back to Ridgefield, with the remaining section becoming 10A

properties.title: Route 5 Spur
properties.description: Designated 1929

properties.title: Route 5N
properties.description: Grandfathered in from 1917 numbering

properties.title: Route 6 Bypass
properties.description: Replaced section became Route 6M

properties.title: Route 7
properties.description: Truncated to Wallington 1929; remaining section became Route 11N

properties.title: Route 8N
properties.description: Grandfathered in from 1917 system; renumbered to 84 in 1942

properties.title: Route 11 (Planned)
properties.description: Intended to be freeway bypass of Rte 28/29, but never built

properties.title: Route 18N
properties.description:
Granfathered in from the 1916 system
Became Route 1 in 1929, S1A south of George Washington Bridge Approach

properties.title: Route 22 (Planned)
properties.description: Planned as a ring road around New York- scrapped soon after planning

properties.title: Route 24
properties.description: With reroute onto freeway in Philipsburg, old section became Route 24-28 Link

properties.title: Route 25
properties.description: North bit designated to go over Route 1 Extension, but this route was not entirely built in 1927; when built, remaining section became Route 25 Truck

properties.title: Route 28-29 Link
properties.description: Later became part of Route 28

properties.title: Route 29
properties.description: From Ringoes to Somerville, realigned over Routes 12 and 30

properties.title: Route 36
properties.description: Because of the impractability of the roads, the route was bypassed by '29

properties.title: Route 41 Spur
properties.description: Bypassed section north of Route 25 became S41N

properties.title: Route 48
properties.description: Section east of Pleasantville was Route 55 from '38-'48

properties.title: Route 55
properties.description: Along with S4D

properties.title: Route 100
properties.description: Later merged into Route 700 (NJ Turnpike)
